title: Tom Probable NDE 6199
content: This experience happened in 1978 when I was 10 years old. I had been sick in false croup for a while with a high fever and a swollen throat. This night my mum had some friends over for dinner and girl talk. I was upstairs in my room and they were in a room downstairs having dinner, talking and smoking. As I recall, my mum was determined not to give me any painkillers, unless absolutely necessary and I remember that night, I was exhausted from the fever and ache. The scent of cigarette smoke made it even worse. I was worried about my condition and wanted to tell my mum but at the same time, I did not want to disturb her. Now, I can't remember exactly what happened but I was in my bed and I must have dozed off. The next thing I remember is the feeling of relief, like all the burden was lifted off my shoulders and all my worries were gone. This was the most incredible feeling. I was in a softy dark, peaceful and beautiful place, walking with someone I knew very well and trusted. It was like I was home and knew the purpose of everything and especially the purpose of my life. I don't know how long I was there or who I was talking to but I think we discussed my life and that we agreed on something. When the experience ended, I woke up panicking from not getting any air. I managed to alert my mom and she took me to the hospital where I stayed for a week. I remember the week in hospital as a very pleasant and happy time and I do think the experience has made me a happier and more relaxed person.
